title: Public Debate: Concession with mindazonáltal
goal: I can grant a point in a public debate with *mindazonáltal* or *annak ellenére, hogy*.
I can name the main terms of public debate (*deliberatív demokrácia, konszenzuskeresés, elszámoltathatóság*).
I can say what makes a debate good.

sections.title: Unit 16: Public Sphere, Rhetorical Framing & Deliberative Communication
body: Texts about public life use concessions, rhetorical questions, the language of audit reports, careful phrases that name a source, and participles that give a background.

This unit follows Bibó István's essay *A kelet-európai kisállamok nyomorúsága* (1946) and his idea of political hysteria. You will learn to read and write about debate, rhetoric, oversight, the press and fear in politics.
